question: What was the name of the legend who spearheaded the Munda Rebellion?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Birsa Munda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Birsa Munda** was a tribal freedom fighter and religious leader from the Munda tribe in present-day Jharkhand, India.
 
• He spearheaded the **Munda Rebellion**, also known as the **Ulgulan (The Great Rebellion)**, against British colonial rule and the feudal system in the Chotanagpur region during the late 19th century.
 
• The rebellion, led by Birsa Munda, aimed to establish the rights of the tribal community over their land and resources, which were being exploited by landlords and British officials.
 
• Birsa Munda is regarded as a symbol of tribal identity and resistance. He also propagated the idea of **religious and social reform** among the tribal people, opposing superstition and encouraging unity.
 
• The Indian government honors his legacy by celebrating his birth anniversary, **15th November**, as **Janjatiya Gaurav Divas** (Tribal Pride Day).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Munda Rebellion**:

 
 
• The Munda Rebellion (1899-1900) was primarily against the **exploitative zamindari system**, which deprived the tribal people of their land ownership.
 
• Birsa Munda's slogan "**Abua Raj seter jana, maharani raj tundu jana**" (Let the kingdom of the queen end and our kingdom be established) became a rallying cry for the movement.
 
 
 
• **Birsa's Vision:**
 
 
• He envisioned a **self-rule** for the tribal people and fought for their **land rights**.
 
• Birsa also emphasized the importance of **social reforms**, advocating against superstitions and practices like witchcraft.
 
 
 
• **Legacy:**
 
 
• Birsa Munda passed away at the young age of **25 years** on **9th June 1900**, but his contributions to India's freedom struggle remain significant.
 
• Several institutions, universities, and government programs are named after him to honor his contributions, including the **Birsa Institute of Technology** and **Birsa Agricultural University**.
 
 
 
• **Other Tribal Leaders:**
 
 
• **Nirmal Munda**: Known for leading the **Tangarpada Movement** in Odisha against British exploitation.
 
• **Kariya Munda**: A prominent political leader from the tribal community and a former deputy speaker of the Lok Sabha.
